about: sim/calibrate.py fit: shared vessel settings fitted to the training runs (per-run optical gain, offset and linear drain free).

A.about: shape fit only: flow returns exactly where arterial pressure clears the cuff, the reference systolic taken as true

B.about: optical pulse held at its real size; opening offset 0 mmHg, chosen so the training twins' hinge bias matches the real one (onset below SBP is physiology)

A2.about: as A, with the optical pulse held at its real size and no opening offset

B-soft.about: as B, but the cuffed artery opens over 20 mmHg (held, not fitted): the soft end of what the real runs allow
